 In MovieWeb’s exclusive sneak peek at 'Nocturne's Episode 5 ("Solitude"), Michael (Landon Valentin) tells his mother Ida (Chrissy Metz) that the Sandman needs her to do something—and if she agrees, he’ll bring her daughter Felicia back. 
 Catch the new episode this Friday, November 20 on Apple TV!
